Microsoft Default Game Profiles provide: Microsoft Default Game Profiles provide optimized TDP and FPS settings for specific games. When this is off, LegionGoBar will not apply Default Game Profiles at all. It is on by default on devices with native profile support (Legion Go Z1/Z2 Extreme); on other AMD devices, turning it on uses Z1 Extreme (OMNI) profiles as a fallback.
